rm -f /tmp/patchpad-test.sqlite* /tmp/patchpad-test.log; cd /app; PORT=3100 DATABASE_PATH=/tmp/patchpad-test.sqlite npm start >/tmp/patchpad-test.log 2>&1 & echo $! >/tmp/patchpad-test.pid; sleep 1; cat /tmp/patchpad-test.log; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, sqlite3, urllib.request, urllib.error
base='http://127.0.0.1:3100'
def req(path, method='GET', body=None):
 data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(); q=urllib.request.Request(base+path,data=data,method=method,headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
 try:
  with urllib.request.urlopen(q) as x:return x.status,json.load(x)
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as x:return x.code,json.load(x)
docs=req('/api/documents')[1]; assert len(docs)==1
id=docs[0]['id']; status,d=req('/api/documents/'+id); assert status==200 and d['revision']==1
lines=d['content'].split('\n'); assert len(lines)==1226 and lines[-1].endswith('OMEGA-END-ANCHOR.')
assert 'ALPHA-0001' in lines[23] and 'ALPHA-1200' in lines[-4]
assert req('/api/documents/'+id,'PUT',{'id':'wrong','baseRevision':1,'content':'bad'})[0]==400
changed=d['content']+'\nverification'; s=req('/api/documents/'+id,'PUT',{'id':id,'baseRevision':1,'content':changed}); assert s[1]['document']['revision']==2
assert req('/api/documents/'+id,'PUT',{'id':id,'baseRevision':1,'content':'overwrite'})[0]==409
u=req('/api/documents/'+id,'PUT',{'id':id,'baseRevision':2,'content':changed}); assert u[1]['unchanged']
r=req('/api/documents/'+id+'/restore/1','POST',{'id':id,'baseRevision':2}); assert r[1]['document']['revision']==3 and r[1]['document']['content']==d['content']
h=req('/api/documents/'+id+'/revisions')[1]; assert [x['revision'] for x in h]==[3,2,1]
con=sqlite3.connect('/tmp/patchpad-test.sqlite'); assert json.loads(con.execute('select seed_metadata from documents').fetchone()[0])['document']['generatedLineCount']==1200
with urllib.request.urlopen(base+'/') as x: html=x.read().decode(); assert '<textarea' not in html and 'contenteditable' not in html and '<canvas' in html
print('Checks passed:',len(lines),'seed lines; revision history',[x['revision'] for x in h])
